About the project

  • We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to join our dynamic team in Cracow, contributing to an exciting digital revolution in the banking sector. You will work on Adobe Experience Manager applications and online experiences, playing a crucial role in enhancing digital capabilities for over 37 million customers worldwide. This position involves collaborating with a global team of experts and requires a strong foundation in AEM, Java, and RESTful services. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to drive innovation in banking, this opportunity may be the right fit for you.

Your responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing specific services based on Adobe Experience Manager for public websites and campaign messaging
  • Migrating and modernizing existing functionalities onto OSGi-based architecture
  • Building and enhancing digital capabilities using the AEM technology stack
  • Coordinating with respective teams during the delivery process
  • Developing and maintaining REST services and ensuring their integration with AEM applications
  • Utilizing Apache Sling and JCR to deliver scalable and secure solutions
  • Writing unit tests using JUnit and AEM Mocks to ensure code quality
  • Managing project dependencies and builds using Maven and GIT
  • Conducting code analysis and maintaining code quality with SonarQube
  • Collaborating with front-end developers to integrate HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript into AEM solutions

Our requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, with at least 2 years of experience in Adobe Experience Manager
  • Very good knowledge of Java and its ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience with REST services and their integration
  • Familiarity with Apache Sling, OSGi, and JCR
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and AEM Mocks
  • Proficiency in using Maven and GIT for project management
  • Understanding of code quality tools like SonarQube
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Advanced level of English

  • PLN 1 000 000 per year for your ideas - with this amount, we support the passions and voluntary actions of our workers
  • Investment in your growth – meetups, webinars, training platform and technology blog – you choose
  • Fantastic atmosphere created by all Sii Power People
